chant.letra:
[Leader]
What are you wearing? What are you wearing?
[Kids]
A red t-shirt! A red t-shirt!

[Leader]
What are you wearing? What are you wearing?
[Kids]
Blue trousers! Blue trousers!

[Leader]
What are you wearing? What are you wearing?
[Kids]
Green socks and yellow shoes!

[Leader]
And what is on your head?
[Kids]
A hat! A hat! A big blue hat!

[All]
T-shirt, trousers, socks and shoes,
jacket, hat — we're ready to move!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Freya is wearing a long green dress,
Nico is wearing a yellow hat.
Astrid has got her jacket on,
Tomás has shorts — imagine that!

[Chorus]
I am wearing, you are wearing,
t-shirt, trousers, skirt and shoes!
Socks and jacket, hat and dress —
tell me what you choose!

[Verse 2]
Curly hair and straight hair too,
short and tall, we're all a crew.
Seven years old, then eight, then nine,
first, second, third — we're right in line!

[Chorus]
I am wearing, you are wearing,
t-shirt, trousers, skirt and shoes!
Socks and jacket, hat and dress —
tell me what you choose!

[Bridge]
Look at me and look at you,
what am I wearing? What are you?

[Chorus]
I am wearing, you are wearing,
t-shirt, trousers, skirt and shoes!
Socks and jacket, hat and dress —
tell me what you choose!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Where is Pip? Where is Pip?
[Kids]
In the kitchen! In the kitchen!

[Leader]
Where is Pip? Where is Pip?
[Kids]
In the bedroom! Under the bed!

[Leader]
Where is Pip? Where is Pip?
[Kids]
In the bathroom! Behind the door!

[Leader]
Where is Pip? Where is Pip?
[Kids]
In the garden! By the wall!

[All]
Kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, garden —
find that puffin, everyone!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Come into my house, the door is open wide,
there's a window in the kitchen looking out.
The living room has pictures on the wall
and a warm wooden floor to walk about.

[Chorus]
Where is the cat? Where is the ball?
It's in the bedroom, down the hall!
Kitchen, bathroom, garden, wall —
this is my house, I love it all!

[Verse 2]
Pip is in the garden by the little tree,
Lucía's in the bathroom, one, two, three.
Rosa's in the kitchen making something sweet
and the living room is where we meet.

[Chorus]
Where is the cat? Where is the ball?
It's in the bedroom, down the hall!
Kitchen, bathroom, garden, wall —
this is my house, I love it all!

[Bridge]
Knock, knock, knock — who's at the door?
Come inside and look around some more!

[Chorus]
Where is the cat? Where is the ball?
It's in the bedroom, down the hall!
Kitchen, bathroom, garden, wall —
this is my house, I love it all!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
There is a bed — where is the bed?
[Kids]
Next to the window! Next to the window!

[Leader]
There is a lamp — where is the lamp?
[Kids]
On the shelf! On the shelf!

[Leader]
There is a toy box — where's the toy box?
[Kids]
Under the bed! Under the bed!

[Leader]
There is a clock — where is the clock?
[Kids]
On the wall! Tick tock, tick tock!

[All]
Bed and lamp and toy box too,
pillow, blanket, me and you!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
There is a bed with a soft white pillow,
there is a blanket, warm and blue.
There is a rug beside the cupboard
and a little lamp that shines for you.

[Chorus]
This is my room, my little room,
there is a picture on the wall.
Toy box, clock and shelf and bed —
goodnight, goodnight to all.

[Verse 2]
Pip is sleeping in the toy box,
one grey feather on the rug.
The clock says ten, the lamp goes off,
the blanket gives a gentle hug.

[Chorus]
This is my room, my little room,
there is a picture on the wall.
Toy box, clock and shelf and bed —
goodnight, goodnight to all.

[Bridge — very soft]
In the cupboard, on the shelf,
under the bed — sleep well yourself.

[Chorus]
This is my room, my little room,
there is a picture on the wall.
Toy box, clock and shelf and bed —
goodnight, goodnight to all.

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Do you like cheese? Do you like cheese?
[Kids]
Yes, I like cheese! Yummy, yummy cheese!

[Leader]
Do you like fish? Do you like fish?
[Kids]
No, I don't like fish! No, no, no!

[Leader]
Do you like cake? Do you like cake?
[Kids]
Yes, I like cake! My favourite cake!

[Leader]
Bread and rice and chicken too?
[Kids]
Yes, we do! Yes, we do!

[All]
I like, I like, I don't like —
tell me what you like tonight!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I like bread and I like cheese,
I like rice with chicken, please!
Nico likes his pizza hot,
Freya likes an egg — I do not!

[Chorus]
I like, I like, I don't like —
tell me what you like!
Cake and ice cream, milk and juice,
my favourite every night!

[Verse 2]
Astrid likes a yellow banana,
Tomás likes an apple, red.
Water when you're very thirsty,
warm milk when you go to bed.

[Chorus]
I like, I like, I don't like —
tell me what you like!
Cake and ice cream, milk and juice,
my favourite every night!

[Bridge]
Yummy, yummy — say it loud!
What's your favourite? Say it proud!

[Chorus]
I like, I like, I don't like —
tell me what you like!
Cake and ice cream, milk and juice,
my favourite every night!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
One apple —
[Kids]
two apples, three apples!

[Leader]
One banana —
[Kids]
two bananas, yellow bananas!

[Leader]
One orange —
[Kids]
two oranges, round and sweet!

[Leader]
One strawberry —
[Kids]
two strawberries, red and small!

[All]
Grapes and mango, pineapple too —
watermelon for me and you!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Green grapes, purple grapes hanging in a row,
one banana, two bananas, yellow in the sun.
A big red watermelon, sweeter than you know,
and a little strawberry for everyone.

[Chorus]
Apples, oranges, mangoes, grapes —
say them all with me!
One is one but two are TWO,
fruit for you and me!

[Verse 2]
Pineapple is spiky, orange is round,
mango juice is dripping on the ground.
Freya counts the apples, one, two, three,
and Pip is hiding in the strawberry tree!

[Chorus]
Apples, oranges, mangoes, grapes —
say them all with me!
One is one but two are TWO,
fruit for you and me!

[Bridge]
Sweet and sweet and sweet again,
squeeze it up and drink the juice!

[Chorus]
Apples, oranges, mangoes, grapes —
say them all with me!
One is one but two are TWO,
fruit for you and me!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Can I have some water?
[Kids]
Yes, you can! A glass of water!

[Leader]
Can I have some milk?
[Kids]
Yes, you can! A cup of milk!

[Leader]
Can I have some juice?
[Kids]
Cold, cold juice for a thirsty day!

[Leader]
Can I have hot chocolate?
[Kids]
Yes! Yes! Hot chocolate, please!

[All]
Water, milk and juice and more —
healthy drinks, that's what they're for!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I am thirsty, very thirsty,
can I have a glass of water, please?
Cold and clear and good for running,
better than the sweets, believe me!

[Chorus]
Can I have, can I have
a cup of milk, a glass of juice?
Lemonade or hot chocolate —
say the words and they're for you!

[Verse 2]
Fruit and vegetables, bread and dairy,
meat and fish to make you strong.
Healthy first and sweets on Sunday,
that's the way we get along.

[Chorus]
Can I have, can I have
a cup of milk, a glass of juice?
Lemonade or hot chocolate —
say the words and they're for you!

[Bridge]
Thirsty, thirsty in the sun —
one big glass for everyone!

[Chorus]
Can I have, can I have
a cup of milk, a glass of juice?
Lemonade or hot chocolate —
say the words and they're for you!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Have you got a dog?
[Kids]
Yes, I have! A big brown dog!

[Leader]
Have you got a cat?
[Kids]
Yes, I have! A small grey cat!

[Leader]
Have you got a fish?
[Kids]
Yes, I have! In a bowl of blue!

[Leader]
Have you got a mouse?
[Kids]
No, I haven't! Not a mouse!

[All]
Dog and cat and bird and fish —
every pet's a little friend!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Have you got a dog with a waggy tail?
Have you got a cat that sleeps all day?
Nico's got a rabbit, small and white,
Astrid's got a bird that sings away.

[Chorus]
Have you got, have you got
a pet to call your friend?
Dog and cat and fish and bird —
we'll love them to the end!

[Verse 2]
A mouse is small, a dog is tall,
a fish says nothing much at all.
Pip is not a pet, he's free,
but he comes back home for tea!

[Chorus]
Have you got, have you got
a pet to call your friend?
Dog and cat and fish and bird —
we'll love them to the end!

[Bridge]
Feed them, brush them, keep them warm —
a pet's a friend in every storm.

[Chorus]
Have you got, have you got
a pet to call your friend?
Dog and cat and fish and bird —
we'll love them to the end!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Moo! Moo! What is it?
[Kids]
It is a cow! It is a cow!

[Leader]
Neigh! Neigh! What is it?
[Kids]
It is a horse! It is a horse!

[Leader]
Oink! Oink! What is it?
[Kids]
It is a pig! A pink, pink pig!

[Leader]
Quack! Quack! What is it?
[Kids]
It is a duck down by the grass!

[All]
Cow and horse and pig and duck,
sheep and goat and hen — good luck!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The sun comes up on the farm at seven,
the hen is looking for a place to sit.
She leaves one egg in the yellow straw
and the goat eats grass — that's it!

[Chorus]
Moo says the cow, neigh says the horse,
oink says the pig in the mud!
It is a sheep, it is a duck,
it is a farm and it is good!

[Verse 2]
The dog runs out and the cat runs in,
the sheep are white, the mud is thick.
Tomás carries a bucket of water,
Freya counts the ducks — that's the trick!

[Chorus]
Moo says the cow, neigh says the horse,
oink says the pig in the mud!
It is a sheep, it is a duck,
it is a farm and it is good!

[Bridge]
Listen, listen, what do you hear?
Say the animal loud and clear!

[Chorus]
Moo says the cow, neigh says the horse,
oink says the pig in the mud!
It is a sheep, it is a duck,
it is a farm and it is good!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
An elephant — big or small?
[Kids]
BIG! Very, very big!

[Leader]
A hamster — big or small?
[Kids]
Small! Very, very small!

[Leader]
A giraffe — short or tall?
[Kids]
Tall! Tall! Very tall!

[Leader]
A tiger — fast or slow?
[Kids]
Fast! Fast! Run, run, run!

[All]
Lion, monkey, hippo, bear —
wild animals everywhere!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The lion is big and the lion is loud,
the monkey is quick and the monkey is proud.
A hippo is heavy, a snake is long,
a parrot is friendly and sings a song.

[Chorus]
It is big! It is small!
It can run and it can climb!
Lion, tiger, bear and hippo —
wild ones all the time!

[Verse 2]
A giraffe can reach the highest leaf,
an elephant is slow but strong.
A rabbit and a hamster are small and soft
and a tiger's stripes are never wrong.

[Chorus]
It is big! It is small!
It can run and it can climb!
Lion, tiger, bear and hippo —
wild ones all the time!

[Bridge]
Scary? No — just big and wild.
Say hello and stay a while!

[Chorus]
It is big! It is small!
It can run and it can climb!
Lion, tiger, bear and hippo —
wild ones all the time!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
There is a boat!
[Kids]
There is a boat on the blue, blue sea!

[Leader]
There are shells!
[Kids]
There are shells on the golden sand!

[Leader]
There is a crab!
[Kids]
There is a crab — run, run, run!

[Leader]
There are fish!
[Kids]
There are fish and they swim and swim!

[All]
Sea and sand and shell and star —
there they are, there they are!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
There is a little boat out on the water,
there are waves that come and go.
There is a crab beneath a broken shell
and a starfish down below.

[Chorus]
There is, there are,
down by the blue, blue sea!
Fish that swim and sand that's warm —
come along with me!

[Verse 2]
Pip is standing on a rock and looking,
Astrid counts the shells she found.
There are footprints in the yellow sand
and a wave that makes a sound.

[Chorus]
There is, there are,
down by the blue, blue sea!
Fish that swim and sand that's warm —
come along with me!

[Bridge]
One is "there is", more is "there are" —
say it right and swim out far!

[Chorus]
There is, there are,
down by the blue, blue sea!
Fish that swim and sand that's warm —
come along with me!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who is it? Who is it?
[Kids]
It's a man! A tall, tall man!

[Leader]
Who is it? Who is it?
[Kids]
It's a woman with a big red bag!

[Leader]
Who is it? Who is it?
[Kids]
It's a boy! It's a girl!

[Leader]
And who is small and fast asleep?
[Kids]
A baby! A baby! Shh, shh, shh!

[All]
Man and woman, boy and girl —
people, people round the world!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
A man walks by with a yellow umbrella,
a woman waves from the shop next door.
A boy and a girl are counting windows,
a baby sleeps on the second floor.

[Chorus]
Man and woman, boy and girl,
one child, two children, more!
Every person has a name —
that's what a name is for!

[Verse 2]
Ana is a girl, Bruno is a boy,
Rosa is a woman, kind and warm.
Juan is a man who mends the bicycles
and Beto is the baby of them all.

[Chorus]
Man and woman, boy and girl,
one child, two children, more!
Every person has a name —
that's what a name is for!

[Bridge]
What's your name? What's your name?
Say it loud — we're not the same!

[Chorus]
Man and woman, boy and girl,
one child, two children, more!
Every person has a name —
that's what a name is for!

20.gramatica: His name is... / Her name is...

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What's his name? What's his name?
[Kids]
His name is Nico! His name is Nico!

[Leader]
What's her name? What's her name?
[Kids]
Her name is Freya! Her name is Freya!

[Leader]
What's her name? The girl over there!
[Kids]
Her name is Ana! She is kind!

[Leader]
And what do good friends do?
[Kids]
Play and share! Play and share!

[All]
His name, her name, yours and mine —
friends together all the time!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
His name is Tomás, he is funny,
her name is Astrid, she is kind.
We share a puzzle in the morning
and a video game we always find.

[Chorus]
His name is, her name is —
say the name of your best friend!
Play together, share together,
friends until the end!

[Verse 2]
Her name is Lía, she can skip,
his name is Bruno, he can run.
We throw the ball, we swap the doll
and everybody has some fun.

[Chorus]
His name is, her name is —
say the name of your best friend!
Play together, share together,
friends until the end!

[Bridge]
A friend is someone who is kind,
a friend is someone you can find.

[Chorus]
His name is, her name is —
say the name of your best friend!
Play together, share together,
friends until the end!
